Where can I spend time outdoors in Nobleton?

Nobleton Community Park, at 15 Old King Road, is a starting point for outdoor recreation. The Township lists a playground and sports amenities; check current access and seasonal availability before your visit.

Park information from King Township

Where is the Nobleton library?

The Nobleton branch of King Township Public Library is at 8 Sheardown Drive. Its official website provides current hours and library information.

Library locations & hours

What’s happening in the community?

For upcoming Township events and schedules, check the official events page. Dates and arrangements can change.

Explore King Township events

Choose a park for the outing you have in mind

For a neighbourhood outing, Davis Park at 45 MacTaggart Drive has a playground, mini-soccer fields and walking trails. Tasca Park, at 49 Parkheights Trail, has a trail and a designated off-leash dog area. Check the Township’s current notices before using the dog park or seasonal facilities.

Park locations and current notices

Make room for a longer walk

Cold Creek Conservation Area is at 14125 11th Concession. King Township lists marked trails, a picnic shelter and opportunities for birdwatching; dogs must remain on leash. For an accessible trail option, the Township identifies the York Regional Forest entrance at 5345 15th Sideroad, with accessible parking. Check current conditions and the route before setting out.

Official trail information and map

Plan a library stop

The Nobleton library is at 8 Sheardown Drive; call 905-859-4188. Its published schedule currently includes Wednesday and Thursday evenings until 8 p.m. The branch is closed on Sundays and Mondays. Check the library’s own hours page for holiday changes before you leave.

Confirm library hours

Local details checked November 9, 2026 against the official sources linked above. Confirm schedules and availability before visiting.
